story.sq01.title: A Light at the Spillway
story.sq01.summary: Verify Mei’s evacuation route and keep its signal lamp working. A tested route is one requirement for Returning Rain.
story.sq01.s1.objective: Read Mei’s route note and inspect the lamp on Lan’s workbench.
story.sq01.s1.journal: Mei marked two usable approaches, not one sacred path. The old lamp is a tool. Repairing it will not bring her back. I need to test a route under today’s water level.
story.sq01.s1.lan: People keep asking which stone she stood on. She moved. When the lower turn flooded, she took the long shelf. Here—her last proper survey, before that night.
story.sq01.s1.apprentice: Then we should check where people can walk now. Does this wick still draw oil?
story.sq01.s1.note: Mei’s route note, thirteen years earlier, three days before the White Tide: “Do not carry the lamp by its hot cage. North shelf: longer, dry above the second water mark. South stair: shorter, safe only while the drain gate stays open. Test with an empty pack before sending children through. Lan, stop calling this your route. I measured it.”
story.sq01.s2.objective: Choose a route, set its physical markers, and walk from the gate to the refuge with the lit lamp.
story.sq01.s2.journal: Both routes can pass inspection. The north shelf needs a raised signal bracket; the south stair needs an open drain and clear tread marks. The journal will record the route I actually test.
story.sq01.s2.lan: The water here is knee-deep today. We can raise the lamp above the shelf rail, or open the drain and mark the stair. Neither is a vow to repeat her last night.
story.sq01.s2.clue: The east-wall gate is approached from the west stair. The ledge under its second rail sounds hollow: both marked routes keep the crooked detour around it. The north shelf clears the second water mark; the south stair clears with the drain secured open. Put the lit lamp before the dangerous turn, never at the gate, and verify the refuge sightline. Its flame is a signal, not a barrier.
story.sq01.s2.choice_a: Use the north shelf; raise the lamp bracket.
story.sq01.s2.choice_b: Use the south stair; secure the drain open.
story.sq01.s2.reply_a: I will mark the longer walk clearly. No one should mistake a short flooded turn for the route.
story.sq01.s2.reply_b: I will put the gate check before the first stair. If it closes, the route sign must point north.
story.sq01.s3.objective: Confirm the refuge sightline, relight the lamp after its burn test, and sign the route inspection.
story.sq01.s3.journal: Returning Rain requirement: spillway route verified. Complete only after the selected route is walked, its condition is marked, and the lamp stays lit through the burn test. Either route qualifies.
story.sq01.s3.lan: The flame did not gutter at the refuge. Write down the gate position and today’s water mark. A working route deserves a date, not a legend.
story.sq01.s3.apprentice: I checked it myself. The next inspection belongs on the board, where everyone can see it.
story.sq01.s3.record: Inspection record: route walked from gate to refuge with the damaged second-rail ledge bypassed; signal bracket secure before the dangerous turn; drain condition posted; lamp burned steadily for ten minutes. Recheck after a major surge and before every evacuation drill. Alternate route remains signed as a fallback.
story.sq01.s3.confirm: Sign the verified route and lamp record.
story.sq01.s3.retry: The inspection is unfinished. Return to the selected route marker; completed checks are saved. You may change routes without losing the lamp repair.
story.sq01.s3.done: Spillway verified. Both practical route choices satisfy the Returning Rain requirement once tested.
story.sq01.epilogue.open: The lamp marks the spillway while the apprentice regulates the reopened river. The inspected refuge route becomes the first regular drill, not a memorial procession.
story.sq01.epilogue.seal: The lamp remains useful after the intake closes. Lan moves its inspection board to the ordinary stream crossing, retaining the tested refuge route for heavy rain.
story.sq01.epilogue.shared: Each spillway shift begins with the lamp and refuge check. Mei’s handwritten warning stays beside the new dated inspections. No one calls the route finished forever.
